raw_text: Has anyone else noticed the flood of anti-India election posts from newly created accounts? I've been tracking at least 40 accounts created in the last 72 hours all pushing identical EVM fraud narratives. The coordination pattern is obvious — same hashtags, same talking points, posted within minutes of each other. This looks like a textbook influence operation.
clean_text: Reddit user identifies coordinated inauthentic behavior with 40 new accounts pushing identical EVM fraud narratives during Indian elections. Coordination pattern noted with synchronized posting.
